pages.title: Backpacks and Storage
pages.text: **Sophisticated Backpacks** and **Sophisticated Storage** share one idea: containers you customise with upgrades. Backpacks go on your back. Storage covers chests, barrels and shulker boxes. Both use the same upgrade system.

pages.title: Backpack
pages.text: Worn on your back; the open key is J here. Tiers climb from the basic backpack through copper, iron, gold, diamond and netherite, each with more slots and upgrade slots.

pages.title: Storage Chests
pages.text: Chests, barrels and shulker boxes come in the same material tiers. Barrels can be limited to a few stacks. Use the Storage Tool to change appearance.

pages.title: Stack Upgrade
pages.text: Multiplies how many items fit per slot. Higher tiers stack more. Conversion recipes upgrade one tier to the next.

Common upgrades:
- Pickup and Magnet collect items (range 2, Advanced 4).
- Filter limits what goes in.
- Feeding eats for you.
- Restock and Refill keep your hotbar full.
- Void and Compacting tidy overflow.
- Smelting, crafting and more.

pages.title: Controller
pages.text: Links many nearby Sophisticated chests and barrels into one big inventory. Add a Storage Link to connect other storage.

Both mods have Create add-ons, so backpacks and storage can ride on contraptions with their upgrades. Backpacks on contraptions use the official Sophisticated Backpacks Create Integration. See [#](2E5AAC)[Contraptions](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#]().\
\
